tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: The house colour: action titles, title and footer rules, message bars, stickers, big numbers, callout band, section dividers, waterfall totals, table rules, arrows and pills. 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: navy-500
tokens.usage: Second data series, waterfall increases, the middle segment of a stack, cover separators. Differs from navy-700 in lightness. 4.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Cover gradient, light end.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Cover gradient, dark end.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Context data (a prior-period bar), waterfall decreases, the top segment of a stack, so-what rule, the footer label's '|' separator, the section label on a navy divider. Never for running text on white.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Benchmark lines (Ø) and the average symbol.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface and panel. 16:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Units, axis labels, legends, sources, annotation leaders. 5.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Chart baselines, the vertical baseline of horizontal bars, card dividers, flag rings. Lines, never fills.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a grey panel.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Grey panels and cards. Ink keeps 14:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide background. Content slides are always white.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.sample: Slower growth is the new normal
styles.usage: Deck title on the cover, white on navy. A statement, not a topic.

styles.name: action-title
styles.sample: After the post-COVID rebound, global growth settled around 3.5%
styles.usage: One per content slide, navy-700, one sentence, two lines at most.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: A key figure or delta, navy-700, bold, clearly larger than its label, the % sign at full size. One for a message, up to four as a row of equals. Always in the sans.

styles.name: chart-title
styles.usage: What the chart measures, with its unit after a comma. navy-700.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: The one sentence in a navy callout band, white, centred.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Energy prices and rapid rate hikes cut growth to 3.3% by 2023.
styles.usage: Body text, annotations, card text. ink.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Bold lead-in that opens a point, and the 'So what:' label.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Values on or above bars; replaces the y-axis. One position per chart: all inside or all outside.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Slide sticker top right, navy-700 in a navy outline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to bar, icon to its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between title, rule and body; between points.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gutter between chart and panel.

tokens.name: margin-side
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin.

tokens.name: margin-top
tokens.usage: Top margin above the action title.

tokens.name: margin-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom zone that holds the footer rule, source and page label.

tokens.name: footer-rule
tokens.usage: Distance of the 3px footer rule from the bottom edge. The check script finds the footer by it.

tokens.name: title-line-max
tokens.usage: No line of an action title may be wider than this share of the content width (1760px). Measured by the check script.

tokens.name: icon-circle
tokens.usage: Bullet icon: white circle (radius-full) left of its text, centred on the text's first line.

tokens.name: icon-glyph
tokens.usage: Icon inside the bullet circle; also the size of inline SVG icons drawn on the 24px grid.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Round flag diameter, with a 2px hairline ring.

tokens.name: arrow-lift
tokens.usage: Trend arrows run between points this far above the bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bars, panels, cards, callout band. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-stamp
tokens.usage: The slide sticker only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon circles, annotation dots, status circles.
